effective_spec.overview: 完整archive/BIN匯入匯出、驗證、單文件合併/Undo與新專案副本候選；保留preflight文件驗收。

architecture.purpose: M06 exchanges a verified independent single-document copy with necessary material versions; validates before action; applies one target-document merge with one Undo or creates a separately authorized new project copy. It never executes imported code or mutates source package.
architecture.hexagonal: Editor/Test → closed exchange commands → DispatchHost ExchangeOwner → HOST BinExchange → existing proposed pure WORK preflight. Output ports: immutable ArchiveSource/ExportStore, M04 capture/candidate commit, M05 material pin/export/import, M01 new-project copy, M07 root observation. Windows adapter implements safe source/export handles. Domain has no archive/filesystem/UI dependency.
architecture.dependency_map: M01 identity +M04 single document owner → M06 capture/plan; M05 immutable versions/pins ↔ M06 copy manifest; M06 validated candidate → M04 one S1 MutationKind::Merge; history roots → M05 five-kind aggregation, including M07 recovery. No M06-owned second document model.

ownership.M06: Immutable source snapshot, validation report, preview mapping/plan and operation evidence.
ownership.M01: New project UUID/directory/definition adoption and publication. Foreign source UUID is provenance only.
ownership.M04: Target content/revision/semantic fingerprint/formal+recovery baselines and Undo/Redo. Only owner commits merge.
ownership.M05: Catalog IDs/version hashes, durable pins and root transitions; eligibility not deletion.
ownership.M07: Recovery payload/index/root evidence; merge/import cannot clear retained snapshots.
ownership.adapter: Safe source handle/owned export staging and bounded stream; not business identity policy.

architecture.transactions: Validate+preview no target content writes. Acquire durable material pin before target commit. M04 single commit atomically replaces one in-memory document and pushes one Undo. Catalog/target/formal file are separate transactions; postcommit root transfer can defer, never false rollback. Export is immutable stage→no-replace publication; new project is separate M01 transaction.
architecture.scope: ESS standalone copy, proposed BIN-v1 self-contained package, validation/incomplete external confirmation, explicit identity mapping, one-document merge+Undo, new project copy. ZIP compatibility, legacy SGB migration, automatic save, execution/build, physical cleanup and cross-document merge are separate tasks.
architecture.approval: Preflight F1-F3 document acceptance preserved, not product or R1-R4 adoption. New choices below pending Owner; no Skeleton.

archive.choice: Recommended A: uncompressed deterministic framed BIN-v1 below, no archive dependency. Alternative B ZIP requires separate exact dependency/feature/lock/security envelope and remains unsupported here. New BIN is not legacy SGB1; no signature guessing, silent conversion or renaming.
archive.framing: 8-byte ASCII magic SGABIN1 followed by LF (hex53 47 41 42 49 4e 31 0a); next8bytes unsigned little-endian manifest length M; then exactly M bytes UTF8 JSON manifest; then entry data concatenated in manifest order. Entry offsets relative to first data byte, contiguous from0, no holes/overlaps/trailing bytes. Checked u64 addition before seek/read. No compression/encryption/symlink attributes or filesystem extraction.
archive.manifest: Fixed fields {schema:"SGA-BIN-v1",version:1,source:{project_uuid,document_uuid,format,semantic_profile,semantic_digest,captured_revision},mode:DocumentWithAssets,entries:[{key,kind,size_bytes,digest,offset}],references:[{asset_id,digest,entry_key}],legacy_alias_mapping:[{alias,asset_id,digest}],missing_external:[{id,kind,target_id?}]}. Unknown/duplicate fields rejected. No self digest; source_digest=SHA256 all exact archive bytes, manifest_digest=SHA256 manifest raw bytes; not approval authority.
archive.entries: Exactly one document key document/payload with kind Document; immutable canonical internal document bytes verified through adopted M04 codec. Material keys assets/<lowerhex64> kind Asset. Unique exact keys, ASCII casefold unique, no other names. References sorted (asset_id UTF8,digest); distinct IDs may share content-digest entry. Every referenced internal asset exists, hash/size exact; every Asset entry used; document unreferenced only special mandatory entry. No arbitrary paths/components, ../,drive,UNC,NUL,backslash,colon,percent decoding or device names.
archive.canonical_export: UTF8 compact JSON, fixed manifest field/record order above, entries document first then asset digest ASCII order; sorted refs/aliases/external IDs by UTF8 bytes. Integers decimal unsigned no floats, offsets exact. No BOM/newline inside manifest. Source timestamps and machine paths omitted. Equal captured canonical content+asset pairs yields equal package bytes; no random container metadata.
archive.guards: Input total bytes cap first → magic/version/header/M range → strict UTF8/duplicate/type/JSON resource parse → entry table names/count/overflow/ranges/final length → streamed digest/size checks → M04 payload/schema/profile/identity/ref checks → exact reference closure/external classification → trusted target freshness → existing preflight policy. Grammar failure never becomes accepted incomplete. Manifest parser depth root0≤64 and per-string decoded UTF8≤1MiB; numeric unsigned u64 integer only.
archive.ess_mode: ESS export emits only full serialized EssXmlV1 aggregate from captured M04 codec. Requires complete material-free or explicitly external-only reference classification; internal assets requiring inclusion => RequiresBin. This is an Owner-proposed scope choice, not silent requirement reduction. Import plain ESS uses M04 codec and trusted project reference resolver; unresolved internal payload/material cannot be excused as external. Unsupported JSON design exchange remains explicit format choice rather than XML coercion.
archive.security: Treat payload/props/metadata inert. Never load scripts, expand archive paths, follow external URLs or execute imported commands. File extension irrelevant to trust; reject SGB1/ZIP/unknown versions deterministically. Duplicate raw JSON keys rejected before typed decode. Source snapshot copied/hashed under native safe handle and cannot reopen changed source by path.

ports.ArchiveSourcePort: capture(trusted_native_selection,max_archive_bytes) -> Box<dyn VerifiedSourceLease>; lease.len()->u64, digest()->lowerhex64, read_range(offset:u64,length:u64)->bounded bytes. Adapter creates owned immutable snapshot or holds nonreplaceable read handle+identity through complete validation/apply. Source modifications/alias ambiguity => SourceChanged/UnsafeIdentity, no stale read.
ports.ArchiveExportPort: begin_owned(trusted_destination_selection,operation_id,max_bytes)->Box<dyn OwnedExport>; stage.append(bytes)->Result; stage.seal_no_replace(expected_digest,expected_length)->ExportReceipt; stage.abort()->AbortReceipt. Collision even empty file AlreadyExists; no overwrite/truncate UI destination. Drop closes only. Partial/unverified publication retains path evidence.
ports.ExportReceipt: {destination_identity,source_capture_id,archive_digest,length,publication_id}; success after exact full hash+flush+durable no-replace publication. Native Windows11 identity/alias/cross-process tests required. This new Port does not extend existing FileCommit private journal or claim atomic streaming replace.
ports.M04_port: capture_exchange(context)->ImmutableDocumentCapture; prepare_merge(captured_target,validated_candidate,mapping)->MergeCandidate; commit_merge(expected_identity,expected_revision,verified_pin,candidate,operation_id)->MergeApplied|MergeAppliedRetentionDeferred. Internally existing S1 prepare/commit MutationKind::Merge, no new domain setter. capture/commit projection complete or fail closed.
ports.M01_port: Existing M01 wizard owner invokes HOST project_copy child at final-path QuarantinedCopy→Ready, fresh project/doc UUID/provenance. Accepted S2 untouched; no independent owner.
ports.ProjectCopyStoragePort: begin_project_copy(final trusted selection,new identity)->QuarantinedProjectCopy; initialize at stable final paths; publish_ready_checked(allproofs)->ProjectCopyReadyReceipt. NO directory rename after any FileCommit catalog/document operation. Official open gates copy-state+committed read proof.
ports.M07_port: read-only registered RecoverySnapshots observation/fence via M05 root collector. No snapshot deletion/baseline mutation. Incomplete provider remains Unknown; missing M07 does not permit pin release.
ports.boundaries: New archive traits live in sgenaxis-ports/archive_exchange.rs, application contracts HOST bin_exchange.rs; adapter archive_exchange.rs implements handles/streaming only. Source/target selection is trusted M01 seam dependency; absent capability returns DependencyNotReady, no user path authority.

merge_undo.preflight: Embed/reuse unchanged R1-R4+accepted F1-F3 exact64oracle document policy. Actual verified decoder creates report; UI cannot submit safe=true/report/blockers. Source digest+target document/revision bound; old report stale => reject. Allowed is not mutation permission/receipt.
merge_undo.identity_mapping: Preview enumerates every imported entity ID and typed internal reference. Recommended FreshImportedIds: server allocates new IDs for all imported entities and shows complete old→new mapping; caller explicitly confirms mapping digest. Alternative explicit mapping to existing target requires each identity and target type confirmed. Same name/label never matches automatically. Any uncertain/unsupported reference-bearing field blocks affected merge. Unknown structure cannot silently preserve a stale hidden reference.
merge_undo.scope: One source document→one selected target document plus necessary immutable assets only. ESS target aggregate work/architecture/design considered one physical document; all affected typed projections validated as one candidate. Any required edit to another physical document => existing CrossDocumentChangeRequired. No automatic new target/project switch during merge.
merge_undo.conflicts: Target project/doc/session/generation/revision and semantic profile/digest captured in plan. Asset pairs preserve explicit versions; catalog may add new version, never changes another document binding/latest pointer. Entity remap updates every supported internal edge/parent/binding; external IDs are preserved as explicit Pending only after allowed external confirmation. Duplicate IDs, cycles, invalid parent/type errors block.
merge_undo.preview: Server plan {plan_id,source_digest,target_identity,revision,before_semantic,candidate_semantic,mapping_digest,asset_manifest_digest,choice,affected_counts,blocked_capabilities,expires_at}; TTL60s monotonic,max16plans/runtime,max64MiB candidate memory. No target writes. Confirm DTO plan_id+preview_digest+operation_id; cannot inject candidate bytes/mapping at confirm.
merge_undo.apply: Revalidate immutable source and target, exact choice/mapping, IO-health and dependency evidence. Import verified assets into catalog +Held Candidate pin before commit. One M04 S1 commit after revalidation, one Undo with before+after complete content/required asset union. No-op produces unchanged revision/no Undo. Source bytes unchanged.
merge_undo.known_failure: Before S1 commit: target content/revision/history/formal+snapshot baselines unchanged; imported immutable catalog versions/orphan blobs may remain pinned/retained. Explicitly distinguish target rollback from removal of safe staged assets; no physical cleanup requirement hidden. Cancel before commit produces no history.
merge_undo.postcommit: Complete roots transfer after one M04 Merge commit; return common AppliedRetentionDeferred if needed, never unchanged failure. Same for Undo; source bytes/formal/recovery baselines unchanged.
merge_undo.undo: Existing M04 S1 undo expected current revision restores complete before state and pushes appropriate redo semantics as supported S1. Only public existing undo operation exposed; do not invent redo API. M05 roots retain versions for other documents/Undo/Redo/recovery/in-flight; Undo never deletes material. Root publication failure after undo=>UndoAppliedRetentionDeferred; keep union pins/old roots.
merge_undo.incomplete: Only ExplicitlyAcceptMissingExternal permits AllowedIncomplete. Store Pending bindings and blocked dependent capabilities in candidate, preserve exact external IDs; never invent valid endpoints/assets. Hard blockers remain first and cannot be bypassed by acceptance. Later resolving binding is separate owner edit with its own revision/history, not silent mutation.
merge_undo.projector_readiness: PROJECTOR_FIXTURES_REQUIRED: exact typed field/ref mapping for allowed ESS/design constructs before merge Skeleton. Uncertain IDs/unknown reference fields hard-block; explicit FreshImportedIds map preview only.

lifecycle.export: M04 stable immutable capture+complete ref projection → M05 durable Export-purpose pin (new pending PinPurpose amendment; not assume enum exists) → verified material copies → deterministic BIN bytes stream → native seal receipt. Export receipt does not ACK formal/recovery saves. Release pin only through M05 complete fresh roots; unavailable roots retain Held. Export pin timeout never deletes materials.
lifecycle.export_failure: Known failure before publish leaves no completed destination; owned stage may remain with explicit AbortFailed. No truncate of pre-existing file. After native publish but response lost return ExportPublishedDeliveryDeferred after proof reconciliation, never Cancelled/not-written. Archive source/destination immutable receipts retained.
lifecycle.validate_import: Capture source lease once, guard bytes, decode full document/material closure, register report+preview. Native source selection stale/size changed => fail. Inspect is not execute; no target mutation/catalog writes during validate/preview.

new_project_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
new_project_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
new_project_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
new_project_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

lifecycle.replay: One apply operation per target at a time; runtime bounded128/session1024/runtime result cache, capacity rejects no eviction. Same operation body returns original receipt; different body ReplayConflict. After commit callback loss, query actual owner receipt; across restart exactly-once not claimed without new durable operation protocol. Never replay lost merge into a fresh target session.
lifecycle.close_switch: Plans/source leases revoked on close/project switch; applied proof and Held pins retained for reconciliation. Cancellation once commit/publish started awaits actual result; cannot claim rollback. Preview plan generation isolation prevents late apply to replacement session.
lifecycle.recovery: M04 RecoveryBlocked denies apply/undo; M05 uncertain catalog denies material import/transfer; new archive store identity uncertainty blocks export. No repair/unblock API. Prior recovery snapshots retained, and imported content will participate in normal M07 checks after actual M04 content mutation.

errors.shape: ExchangeError {code,stage,path?,reason,plan_id?,operation_id?,evidence?}; result variants ValidationBlocked|NeedsExternalConfirmation|PreviewReady|ExportPublished|MergeApplied|NoChange|MergeAppliedRetentionDeferred|UndoAppliedRetentionDeferred|ProjectCopyDeferred|Error; success/error/deferred semantics exclusive.
errors.ordering: Caller authorization/closed DTO→source byte/header bounds→lexical manifest and resource guards→table path/range/digest integrity→document codec/typed closure→actual preflight exact precedence→explicit external choice→identity mapping→target/dependency freshness→catalog pin→owner commit→root transfer. Error paths manifest RFC6901, document path per M04 profile; infrastructure paths only authorized diagnostics.
errors.preservation: Keep original ImportPreflightError, CommitError, MaterialError fields; never map hard blocker to missing_external. Known precommit target preservation distinct from catalog retained orphans; committed deferred never ordinary rollback failure.
errors.min_cases: 0byte archive, truncated1..15header, M=0/too-large, u64 overflow, same-size source changed, raw duplicatekey, named extra entry, corrupt payload/assets all explicit negative recipes. No ZIP bombs: ZIP/compression unsupported rather than invoking a decoder.

ui.internal_undo: Use existing adopted M04 document_undo with target context, not new independent M06 history manager.
ui.states: Validation blockers separated from external warnings. Explicit external acceptance unchecked default; disabled for any hard blocker. Preview exact one target, mappings, assets, Pending bindings and one-Undo effect; confirm/cancel. Deferred applied state displays actual target revision and retained pin; error preserves active draft. New project copy clearly separate action.
ui.ACL: Editor only; Viewer cannot import/export/apply/copy. UI sends no raw arbitrary root/path, manifest safe flags, approval refs or candidate bytes at confirm. IDs ASCII1..128, deny unknown fields, trust actual window instance not label.
ui.accessibility: Keyboard choose/review/confirm/cancel; blocker focus, aria-live progress/deferred; no success toast from validation-only report.

decisions.proposal: Adopt framed uncompressed BIN-v1 A and strict manifest/table/closure limits; ZIP/SGB compatibility separate; ESS internal-material export RequiresBin choice explicit.
Adopt immutable source/export Ports and native no-replace publication; no imported execution/extraction/dependency downloads.
Adopt exact preflight R1-R4 plus already document-accepted F1-F3 without semantic weakening; hard blockers never bypassed.
Adopt explicit preview FreshImportedIds mapping and one-document M04 Merge/Undo, no label matching/hidden cross-document edits.
Adopt M05 verified import/export pins (new Export purpose), roots and postcommit deferred statuses; separate M07 preservation.
Adopt explicit M01 new-project copy seam/new identities/provenance and partial-publication blocked outcomes; no inherited approval or cross-document Undo.
Adopt commands/errors/replay/cancel/envelope and acceptance gates; product remains not ready before dependencies/Skeleton/RED.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: Server-derived immutable WorkflowContext {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:U64,captured_revision:U64,workflow_id:UUID}; no transition operation_id in context. Runtime authority never comes from labels/DTO.

U64Decimal.semantic_validation: parse checked u64 <=18446744073709551615; reject JSON number; never JS Number conversion

wire_schema.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.

request_digest.algorithm: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 of ENTIRE validated request value, including body recursively. No field projection, ignored fields, defaults or post-hash enrichment. Authentication resolves every opaque handle before frozen body assembly. Server resolved identity/content/evidence fields shown in schema are mandatory.
canonicalization: Reject duplicates before object construction; unknown/missing/null outside declared union reject before replay lookup and IO.
Object names sorted by UTF8 bytes. All scalar text valid Unicode scalar values; no normalization.

Strings: quote and backslash escaped, backspace/tab/newline/formfeed/carriage-return as \b/\t/\n/\f/\r; remaining U+0000..001F as lowercase \u00xx; other scalars literal UTF8; no slash escaping/BOM/whitespace.
All integers U64Decimal strings checked in range. No numeric JSON tokens in transition hash schema.
Arrays preserve admitted order, including resolve requests, entries, aliases, roots, evidence and assets. Order changes conflict; do not sort/deduplicate after hashing.

Same key and valid changed body => ReplayConflict before IO; exact same bytes replay retained receipt. Invalid body => InvalidRequest before key lookup. SHA collision resistance assumed, not proved by vectors.
request_digest.excluded: Transport correlation, UI display strings outside declared operation, transient read handles and secrets are not request inputs. Any new behavior-affecting input requires schema/replan; cannot silently exclude.
request_digest.generated_outputs: Pin id created by pin/import is OUTPUT, never caller input. Existing pin_id mandatory for transfer/release. Selection handles freeze full native identity/raw digest/metadata before hash; bundle entries include all admitted metadata and alias mapping.
request_digest.read_only_calls: validate_pin/read_pinned_version/register_roots do not use transition receipt key; authorization and bounds still apply. Provider registration lifecycle unchanged.

replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

proof_registry_record.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.request_digest: SHA256 of full validated SGA-TRANSITION-v2 request; no v1 projected digest accepted as v2 proof
fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here
fields.request_protocol: SGA-TRANSITION-v2; new candidate field, existing pending schema proposal only

proof_registry_record.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
proof_registry_record.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
proof_registry_record.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

store_read_contract.grant: Crate-private trusted constructor in M05 application composition: immutable store_identity,pin_id,workflow_id,asset_id,digest,size,pin_catalog_generation; issued only after verified Held or Transferred pin membership. Released pin denied. Not deserializable from UI.
store_read_contract.preconditions: 0 < max_bytes <= M05 existing admitted blob limit; expected_size<=max_bytes; grant exact pair/size/store matches. Acquire safe native immutable object handle, reject alias/reparse/size/hash mismatch, no path/URI returned as authority.
store_read_contract.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
store_read_contract.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

mutation_wire_result.precommit_error: {ok:false,error:closed existing error}; zero content commit. Once S1 commit occurred cannot use ErrorUnchanged, undo rollback or failed toast implying no effect.
mutation_wire_result.ui: Show installed revision plus material retention pending; preserve Held, disable unsafe pin release/export until proofs complete. Replay returns original result, never reapply or overwrite newer projection. Writer transfer has separate BindingProjection result, never fabricate mutation/history.

lifecycle.event: same authorized request, binding current, identical body
lifecycle.result: Retained exact outcome; replayed=true; do not reapply, downgrade newer UI projection or revalidate new revision in place of captured revision.
ReplayConflict before any dependency IO; no new ordinal to evade conflict.

lifecycle.event: old binding closed, writer transferred or window instance replaced
lifecycle.result: Validate caller/instance/binding first: UnauthorizedCaller or MissingBinding or StaleOwner; old runtime result is not disclosed to new authority. No resubmit on fresh binding.
Owner finishes already admitted operation under captured authority only; keep evidence/Held. No delivery to stale window. New binding cannot claim same runtime request.

lifecycle.event: process restart or runtime record missing
lifecycle.result: UnverifiedOutcome if admitted request cannot be authenticated in current runtime; old binding normally MissingBinding first. No automatic mutation retry or recreation. Durable issuer lookup is internal authenticated reconciliation only, not new H2 command.

lifecycle.event: authenticated durable material lookup succeeds after restart
lifecycle.result: May establish material transition only; cannot establish runtime install/Undo success or ACK. Fresh owner open and explicit new intent required; prior uncertainty remains recorded.
AppliedRetentionDeferred with original revisions, pin and mutation proof; never rollback, unchanged failure, automatic release or fabricated success.

h2_error_lifecycle.postcommit_stage: LiveRoots for install; UndoRoots for Undo outgoing retention; RedoRoots for retained redo root, according to actual failed root target. Multi-root failure reports first failed stage in declared order LiveRoots,UndoRoots,RedoRoots; retain all unresolved pins.
h2_error_lifecycle.uncertainty: UnverifiedOutcome does not assert zero changes. UI shows outcome unknown and requires reconciliation, preserves draft and disables blind retry. Other precommit failures assert zero content commit only when commit is positively known not attempted.

wire_contract.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_contract.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_contract.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_contract.Context: Server-derived immutable WorkflowContext {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:U64,captured_revision:U64,workflow_id:UUID}; no transition operation_id in context. Runtime authority never comes from labels/DTO.

cross_owner_proofs.ResolutionSnapshot: {WorkflowContext,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; same immutable workflow across pin/transfer; no transition operation_id in context.
cross_owner_proofs.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer receipt lookup with issuer/kind/WorkflowContext/target/evidence validation per proof_registry_record; no trusted DTO body. Missing runtime-only issuer record => UnverifiedOutcome.
cross_owner_proofs.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

effective_spec.module_readiness: NOT_READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION; explicit golden/projector/native/provider gates remain; no Skeleton/product changes.

wire_schema.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.

request_digest.algorithm: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 of ENTIRE validated request value, including body recursively. No field projection, ignored fields, defaults or post-hash enrichment. Authentication resolves every opaque handle before frozen body assembly. Server resolved identity/content/evidence fields shown in schema are mandatory.
canonicalization: Reject duplicates before object construction; unknown/missing/null outside declared union reject before replay lookup and IO.
Object names sorted by UTF8 bytes. All scalar text valid Unicode scalar values; no normalization.

Strings: quote and backslash escaped, backspace/tab/newline/formfeed/carriage-return as \b/\t/\n/\f/\r; remaining U+0000..001F as lowercase \u00xx; other scalars literal UTF8; no slash escaping/BOM/whitespace.
All integers U64Decimal strings checked in range. No numeric JSON tokens in transition hash schema.
Arrays preserve admitted order, including resolve requests, entries, aliases, roots, evidence and assets. Order changes conflict; do not sort/deduplicate after hashing.

Same key and valid changed body => ReplayConflict before IO; exact same bytes replay retained receipt. Invalid body => InvalidRequest before key lookup. SHA collision resistance assumed, not proved by vectors.
request_digest.excluded: Transport correlation, UI display strings outside declared operation, transient read handles and secrets are not request inputs. Any new behavior-affecting input requires schema/replan; cannot silently exclude.
request_digest.generated_outputs: Pin id created by pin/import is OUTPUT, never caller input. Existing pin_id mandatory for transfer/release. Selection handles freeze full native identity/raw digest/metadata before hash; bundle entries include all admitted metadata and alias mapping.
request_digest.read_only_calls: validate_pin/read_pinned_version/register_roots do not use transition receipt key; authorization and bounds still apply. Provider registration lifecycle unchanged.

replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

issuer_proof_records.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

issuer_proof_records.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
issuer_proof_records.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
issuer_proof_records.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

U64Decimal.description: Checked runtime u64 <=18446744073709551615; no JSON number or JS Number

wire_schema.legacy_descriptors: Historical prose only; old blanket-converted Candidate/Select/Preview/Intent/common scalar descriptors superseded by exact named roots. No silent inferred schema.

effective_spec.transition_identity_binding: WorkflowContext immutable across child calls; derive per-role TransitionKey per common replay_protocol. Existing UI request UUID is runtime request ID, not reused as catalog operation key. Pin receipt never proves runtime content commit or formal ACK.

wire_field_inventory.default_for_declared_internal_u64: All other proposed UI inputs/outputs/errors with typed u64 field must use common U64Decimal; source format numeric data/persisted schema excluded. Exact command DTO fixture coverage remains acceptance gate, not inferred from prose.

v3_schema_roots.interpretation: Each named FILE is schema root, never DTO prose subtree or ModuleSpec. Local refs resolve within file. No network resolution.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: v2 common definitions replace v1 common and exact listed module pointers only after Owner adoption. Original embedded behavior rows are historical trace, not competing runtime protocol. Context means WorkflowContext, operation_id means TransitionKey.operation_id at every material call. No in-place update to original Approved artifacts.

wire_types.Context: Server-derived immutable WorkflowContext {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:U64,captured_revision:U64,workflow_id:UUID}; no transition operation_id in context. Runtime authority never comes from labels/DTO.

material_api.import: import(WorkflowContext,TrustedSourceSelection,ImportMetadata,TransitionKey)->ImportedPinnedManifest; native source bytes verified before durable immutable import; no UI path authority
material_api.register_roots: register_roots(TrustedProviderCapability,RootKind)->RootRegistration; internal trusted composition only; no UI registration/callback
material_api.publish_roots: publish_roots(RootRegistration,expected_epoch:u64,RootManifest,TransitionKey)->RootObservationReceipt; owner provider attests current fenced manifest; stale epoch => StaleRoots, unknown => Unknown not empty

proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer receipt lookup with issuer/kind/WorkflowContext/target/evidence validation per proof_registry_record; no trusted DTO body. Missing runtime-only issuer record => UnverifiedOutcome.

quarantine_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

source_reservation.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
source_reservation.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
source_reservation.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.
source_reservation.scope: New committed_read.rs ports/adapter/native tests plus generation_sources.rs application provider adapters. Only proposed exact child files below; accepted IO implementation not re-approved automatically.

recovery_readiness.LocalIntegrityReady: Native coherent recovery index+payload+ALL material copies and hashes/schema verified; independent from original catalog availability.
recovery_readiness.PublicationAcknowledged: Original M05 root transfer receipt and original captured S1 Published/ACK verified.
recovery_readiness.restore: LocalIntegrityReady permits explicit restore to authorized destination even SourceRetentionDeferred. Destination import+durable pin+M04 new-unsaved install mandatory; original Held/Unknown retained and no fake original Published/ACK. Missing/corrupt local blob always blocks.

reservation_kinds.FormalWriteReservation: blocks same-owner content edits until matching IO completion; read diagnostics allowed.
reservation_kinds.RecoveryAttemptReservation: one recovery attempt; after immutable capture+pin, live healthy owner may edit. Never reuse formal saving state for whole recovery copy pipeline.
reservation_kinds.CatalogLease: short transition only, no callbacks into document owner while held.

Public FileCommitPort unchanged.

U64Decimal.semantic_validation: parse checked u64 <=18446744073709551615; reject JSON number; never JS Number conversion

wire_schema.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.
replay_protocol.request_digest: SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON canonical value tree: object keys UTF8 byte sorted; strings JSON escaping as SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1; integers decimal strings; arrays retain order; no whitespace/BOM). Input: {protocol:"SGA-TRANSITION-v1",issuer,role,ordinal,context,source_receipt_ids,target_identity,asset_pairs,root_manifest_ids,expected_catalog_generation}; all fields present, absent option=null; asset_pairs sorted(asset_id,digest); root_manifest_ids sorted unique. Exact bytes document fixtures required before RED.
replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

proof_registry_record.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
proof_registry_record.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
proof_registry_record.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

store_read_contract.grant: Crate-private trusted constructor in M05 application composition: immutable store_identity,pin_id,workflow_id,asset_id,digest,size,pin_catalog_generation; issued only after verified Held or Transferred pin membership. Released pin denied. Not deserializable from UI.
store_read_contract.preconditions: 0 < max_bytes <= M05 existing admitted blob limit; expected_size<=max_bytes; grant exact pair/size/store matches. Acquire safe native immutable object handle, reject alias/reparse/size/hash mismatch, no path/URI returned as authority.
store_read_contract.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
store_read_contract.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

mutation_wire_result.precommit_error: {ok:false,error:closed existing error}; zero content commit. Once S1 commit occurred cannot use ErrorUnchanged, undo rollback or failed toast implying no effect.
mutation_wire_result.ui: Show installed revision plus material retention pending; preserve Held, disable unsafe pin release/export until proofs complete. Replay returns original result, never reapply or overwrite newer projection. Writer transfer has separate BindingProjection result, never fabricate mutation/history.
